title: OpenAgentRulesDocument
description: Open Agent Rules (OAR) document: either a rule (kind schema|policy|invariant|detector, [OAR-DOC-2]) or a hint (kind hint, [OAR-HINT-1]). The document world is closed: any key the matching branch does not declare is rejected, except x- extensions ([OAR-DOC-19]). Normative spec: https://openagentrules.org/spec/1.0/.

spec_version.description: OAR spec version this document targets. An engine implementing M.n accepts major M at minor n or below, and rejects any other ([OAR-DOC-3]).

id.description: Stable rule identifier ([OAR-DOC-4]). The identifier a decision carries ([OAR-EVAL-7]).

namespace.description: Publisher scope. Rule identity is (namespace, id); absent means the loading host's own scope. The rendered Code: line stays the bare id ([OAR-DOC-20], [OAR-DOC-21]).

kind.description: Formal tier. Fixes evaluation order and nothing else ([OAR-DOC-6], [OAR-EVAL-2]).

severity.description: Telemetry and presentation only. Never affects selection, evaluation, ordering, precedence, or the returned decision ([OAR-DOC-7]).

on.description: The anchor this rule binds: a core anchor id resolved through the anchor profile map, or a host-native anchor id ([OAR-SEL-1], [OAR-PROF-3], [OAR-PROF-4]).

effect.description: The decision effect when the rule fires ([OAR-DOC-8]).

when.description: Condition expression over the declared fact environment (section 5). Absent means satisfied ([OAR-DOC-9]).

flow.description: Ordered step names matched against the recent activity window ([OAR-DOC-10], [OAR-FACT-10]).

enforcement.description: monitor evaluates and records without acting ([OAR-DOC-11], [OAR-EVAL-8]).

mandatory.description: When true, the rule is enforced whenever selected and no host mechanism may disable it ([OAR-DOC-12], [OAR-OPS-5]). A mandatory rule cannot be monitored ([OAR-OPS-9]).

on_error.description: Behaviour when a fact provider or detector errors: fail_closed, fail_open, or a rule identifier to substitute ([OAR-DOC-13]).

on_fire.description: Declared engine side-effects run when the rule fires, from the closed vocabulary of section 6 ([OAR-DOC-14]).

stream.description: Streaming evaluation mode for output and tool_result anchors ([OAR-DOC-15]).

what.description: Presentation copy: what happened ([OAR-DOC-18], Appendix B).

cause.description: Presentation copy: what caused it ([OAR-DOC-18], Appendix B).

why.description: Presentation copy: why it matters ([OAR-DOC-18], Appendix B).

fix.description: Presentation copy: how to fix it ([OAR-DOC-18], Appendix B).

instead.description: Presentation copy: what to do instead ([OAR-DOC-18], Appendix B).

message.description: Presentation copy: the one-line message ([OAR-DOC-18], Appendix B).

requires_facts.description: Facts this rule needs. A host that does not provide one rejects the rule at load, naming both ([OAR-DOC-22], [OAR-PROF-6]).

profile.description: Informational record of the author's intent. Carries no behaviour — portability is determined by the anchor and the facts ([OAR-DOC-23]).

^x-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: Implementation extension. Ignored by other implementations ([OAR-DOC-19]).

id.description: The code the host raises; the key the hint is registered under ([OAR-HINT-2]).

kind.description: A hint document is never selected or evaluated ([OAR-HINT-1]).

cause.description: Static presentation copy: what caused it ([OAR-HINT-3]).

why.description: Static presentation copy: why it matters ([OAR-HINT-3]).

fix.description: Static presentation copy: how to fix it ([OAR-HINT-3]).

instead.description: Static presentation copy: what to do instead ([OAR-HINT-3]).

message.description: Static presentation copy: the one-line message ([OAR-HINT-3]).

^x-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: Implementation extension. Ignored by other implementations ([OAR-DOC-19]).

owasp_llm.description: OWASP LLM Top 10 tags (e.g. LLM01). Telemetry/docs only ([OAR-DOC-16]).

mitre_atlas.description: MITRE ATLAS technique tags. Telemetry/docs only ([OAR-DOC-16]).

detector.description: Detector seam: the condition is delegated to a registered detector ([OAR-DOC-17]).
